description: Whether one class may read, write, or execute under a mode. Pass the class that applies: on a real system the owner class is used for the owner even when the group bits differ. setuid, setgid and sticky do not grant the bit. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/permission-check
